summary: Saskatchewan tower site known only from a position listing, a Canada Lookouts index entry and one jumbled towermen row. No build date or present condition found.

evidence.supports: Listed name and position of Parkridge
April Swartz is listed beside Park Ridge, Divide, with no years
Park Ridge is on the Canada Lookouts list of Saskatchewan lookouts

notes_for_editor: Very thin. The position listing has no height, year or notes. The towermen table is jumbled: the April Swartz pairing with Park Ridge, Divide is inferred from layout and may be wrong, so the story hedges it. A dedicated Canada Lookouts page for Park Ridge was not found at the two addresses tried (both 404). Spelling differs: Parkridge (listing) and PARK RIDGE (Canada Lookouts); the brief uses Parkridge. The brief's agency field is not supported by any page read (see Nelson Hill note). Do not confuse with the Ridge Tower named on the towermen list.
